name: qwen36-tt
description: Qwen3.6-27B, a hybrid of 48 Gated-DeltaNet and 16 full-attention layers, ported to an 8-card Blackhole p150b mesh. Ships the device runtime, a chunk-parallel on-device Gated-DeltaNet prefill kernel, bfp8 and bfp4 weight presets, a host-free decode trace with on-device sampling, exact Hugging Face token parity, and per-technique write-ups including the dead ends. Reports measured LongBench decode and time-to-first-token numbers with one-command reproduction.
author: anyin233
